us.notes: HTS 6403: MFN 10% + forced-labor 10%/12.5% + China 25% additional. EU origin capped at 15%.

eu.notes: Footwear MFN 8-17%. US-origin goods: 15% ceiling under EU-US deal.

uk.notes: UK Global Tariff. Textile uppers 4.7-16.9%, leather 8%.

china_market.notes: China MFN 8-10% for sports footwear. General tariff 100% for non-MFN.

brazil.notes: Brazil raised import tax 10-35% additional in 2026. Footwear at 35% for non-Mercosur.

mexico.notes: Mexico raised tariffs Jan 2026. Footwear 10-35%. 50% on non-FTA origins.

india_market.notes: India BCD on footwear reduced from 35% to 20% in Feb 2025. Personal imports 10%.
